notes:
Crisp understands "its shaky" the way you meant it.

Typing "it's shaky" asked Crisp to steady your clip, but dropping the apostrophe — "its shaky" — reached nothing at all, because Crisp read that "its" as belonging to something. It now tells the two apart. Same for "its wobbly" and "its jittery", which previously only worked if you mentioned the camera.
